subject: Pinned Mesa exact descriptor references and storage distinction
body: Use gpu/build/mesa-native-src/src/panfrost/lib/pan_texture.c:1032-1055 for arch9 payload ordering: layer outer, level inner; cubefaces are layers; Valhall fuses samples into one plane descriptor (do not emit one plane per sample). sampled emit1213-1262 carries dimension/depth-or-samples, swizzle, levels,array_size,LOD bounds. storage emit1267-1322 additionally requires no compressed/AFBC/AFRC storage, identity RGBA swizzle, min/maxLOD0 and minimum_level0. Cube layer count must be divisible by6 (1156-1165). panvk_vX_sampler.c104-178 packs border RGBA, flipped compare function, LOD/aniso; reduction mode is PAN_ARCH>=10 only, so do not claim arch9 min/max reduction by writing arch10 fields. panvk_vX_nir_lower_descriptors.c879-912 rewrites image deref to bound resource index. Please derive golden tests from these independent functions/pack structs.
